ideas.children_he: ה׳ אוֹמֵר לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן שֶׁחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב יִהְיֶה הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּשָּׁנָה שֶׁל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
ideas.children_en: God speaks to Moses and Aaron in Egypt and declares this month the first of Israel’s year. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: כָּל מִשְׁפָּחָה תִּבְחַר טָלֶה אוֹ גְּדִי בֶּן שָׁנָה, בָּרִיא וְשָׁלֵם, לְקָרְבַּן הַפֶּסַח. מִשְׁפָּחָה קְטַנָּה תַּחְלֹק אוֹתוֹ עִם שָׁכֵן.
ideas.children_en: Each family must choose a Passover lamb; small households join a neighbor, and the lamb must be an unblemished year-old male. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: בַּיּוֹם הָאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת קָרְבַּן הַפֶּסַח. יִמְרְחוּ מִדָּמוֹ סָבִיב הַפֶּתַח וְיֹאכְלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר צָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ.
ideas.children_en: The lamb is kept until the fourteenth day, slaughtered at twilight, its blood placed on the doorposts and lintel, and its meat roasted and eaten without leftovers. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: הָעָם יֹאכַל כְּשֶׁהוּא לָבוּשׁ וּמוּכָן לָצֵאת. הַדָּם עַל הַפֶּתַח יְסַמֵּן אֶת הַבָּתִּים שֶׁה׳ יָגֵן עֲלֵיהֶם בַּלַּיְלָה.
ideas.children_en: The Israelites eat dressed and ready to leave, while the plague of the firstborn passes through Egypt and the blood on their homes becomes a sign of protection. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: חַג הַפֶּסַח יַזְכִּיר לְבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַיְּצִיאָה מִמִּצְרַיִם. גַּם הַיְלָדִים וְהַנְּכָדִים יַמְשִׁיכוּ לַחְגֹּג אוֹתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Passover is established as a memorial festival to the Lord, observed by Israel throughout the generations as an eternal ordinance. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: בְּמֶשֶׁךְ שִׁבְעָה יָמִים אוֹכְלִים מַצּוֹת וּמַרְחִיקִים חָמֵץ מִן הַבָּתִּים. הַיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי הֵם יְמֵי קֹדֶשׁ.
ideas.children_en: For seven days the people eat unleavened bread and remove leaven from their homes; the first and seventh days are holy assemblies, and leaven is forbidden throughout Israel. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה אוֹמֵר לְמַנְהִיגֵי הָעָם לִשְׁחֹט אֶת קָרְבַּן הַפֶּסַח. בְּעֶזְרַת עַנְפֵי אֵזוֹב, צֶמַח קָטָן, יִמְרְחוּ דָּם עַל הַפְּתָחִים וְיִשָּׁאֲרוּ בַּבַּיִת עַד הַבֹּקֶר.
ideas.children_en: Moses instructs Israel’s elders to slaughter the Passover, apply its blood with hyssop to the doorways, and remain indoors until morning as an enduring statute. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: הַהוֹרִים יְסַפְּרוּ לַיְלָדִים שֶׁה׳ הִצִּיל אוֹתָם בְּלֵיל הַפֶּסַח. הָעָם עוֹשֶׂה כְּדִבְרֵי ה׳, וּבַחֲצוֹת הַמַּכָּה פּוֹגַעַת בִּבְכוֹרֵי מִצְרַיִם.
ideas.children_en: The command is to be kept in the promised land and taught to children; Israel obeys, and at midnight the firstborn of Egypt are struck, causing a great cry. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: פַּרְעֹה קוֹרֵא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן בַּלַּיְלָה וְאוֹמֵר לָהֶם לָצֵאת עִם הָעָם וְהַבְּהֵמוֹת. הַמִּצְרִים מְמַהֲרִים אוֹתָם כִּי הֵם מְפַחֲדִים לָמוּת.
ideas.children_en: Pharaoh summons Moses and Aaron at night and orders Israel to leave Egypt, worship God, and take their flocks and herds. The Egyptians urgently drive them out in fear that everyone will die. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לוֹקְחִים אֶת הַבָּצֵק לִפְנֵי שֶׁהִסְפִּיק לִתְפֹּחַ. הֵם לוֹקְחִים גַּם כְּלֵי כֶסֶף, זָהָב וּבְגָדִים מִן הַמִּצְרִים.
ideas.children_en: The Israelites carry unleavened dough along with silver, gold, and garments obtained from the Egyptians through the favor God gave them. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: הָעָם יוֹצֵא מֵרַעְמְסֵס לְסֻכּוֹת עִם הַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת וְהַבְּהֵמוֹת. הֵם אוֹפִים מַצּוֹת כִּי לֹא הָיָה זְמַן לַבָּצֵק לִתְפֹּחַ.
ideas.children_en: Israel leaves Rameses for Succoth in a vast multitude with families, a mixed group, and abundant flocks and herds. They bake unleavened cakes because they were driven out and had no time to prepare provisions. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: הַכָּתוּב מַזְכִּיר תְּקוּפָה שֶׁל אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה. בְּסוֹפָהּ יָצָא הָעָם מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּלַיְלָה שֶׁבּוֹ ה׳ שָׁמַר עָלָיו.
ideas.children_en: After four hundred and thirty years in Egypt, all the hosts of Israel depart on that very day. The night is a night of vigil for God, remembered by Israel for all generations. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: אֶת קָרְבַּן הַפֶּסַח אוֹכְלִים בְּבַיִת אֶחָד וְאֵין שׁוֹבְרִים בּוֹ עֶצֶם. יֵשׁ כְּלָלִים לַמִּשְׁתַּתְּפִים, וְהֵם חָלִים גַּם עַל מִי שֶׁמִּצְטָרֵף לְעַם יִשְׂרָאֵל.
ideas.children_en: The Passover rules are given: a foreigner, resident, or hired worker may not eat it, while a circumcised purchased slave may. It is eaten in one house, its meat is not taken outside, no bone is broken, and one law applies to native and resident stranger alike after circumcision. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַיְּמִים אֶת צִוּוּי ה׳ לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן. בְּאוֹתוֹ יוֹם ה׳ מוֹצִיא אוֹתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם.
ideas.children_en: All the Israelites do exactly as God commanded Moses and Aaron. On that very day, God brings them out of Egypt in organized hosts. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.
